title: dumasia yunnanensis var. arunachalensis
intro: Dumasia yunnanensis var. arunachalensis, commonly known as Arunachal Dumasia or Yunnan Dumasia, is a plant species belonging to the family Leguminosae. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing fever, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Dumasia yunnanensis var. arunachalensis include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-bacterial activities, making it a potential treatment for pain relief, digestive issues, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
